$comment: AC-41 approved call-site inventory — the source of truth for the gate.
VERSION-CONTROLLED ON PURPOSE: this file is reviewed as its own diff, and it is
never regenerated by the gate. If the gate wrote it, the gate would be tautological.
KEYS ARE REFACTOR-STABLE AND LINE-NUMBER-FREE: file + enclosing symbol + call method
+ canonical argument text + permitted occurrence count. Reformatting, quote-style
changes and property reordering do NOT trip it; changing an argument, the enclosing
function, or the call method DOES, as D4 (changed occurrence requiring review).
`conditions` — the REQUIREMENT side: the width conditions AC-41 names and how many
occurrences the requirement demands in total. Derived from QA-004
§4 / ENG-005 §4.4 / ENG-006 P-6, i.e. the accepted AC-41 text — NOT
from whatever the tree happens to contain.
`entries`    — the SITE side: which call site is allowed to declare which condition,
where, and how many times. If the tree and `conditions` disagree,
the requirement pass fails even when every entry matches.
derived_from: QA-003 N-11 (4 JS conditions, 3 files, 3 thresholds; `sizes=` hints are not queries)
QA-004 §4 (strengthened AC-41 shipped as eng005/eng006_ac41.sh; P-6 named the >= limit)
ENG-005 §4.4-4.5 (condition list 2/1/1 and the three mutants ac41a/b/c)
ENG-006 P-6 (an added site of a known condition must FAIL — this inventory replaces the count)
ENG-003 §11.1 AC-41 (Tailwind screens unmodified; hero keeps 100svh)

conditions.why: Two approved call sites: Navbar closes the mobile menu when the viewport reaches lg; useHeroParallax enables the desktop parallax branch. Tailwind lg = 1024px; the value is not free to change.
One approved call site: useHeroParallax's mobile parallax branch, exactly ONE PIXEL BELOW lg so desktop and mobile are complementary and never overlap. QA-003 N-11 rejected harmonising 1023 to 1024.
One approved call site: HeroVideo swaps its video source below Tailwind's md boundary (768px), i.e. at <= 767px. Changing 767 to 768 changes which widths get the mobile asset.

entries.requirement: QA-004 §4 / ENG-005 §4.4: `navbar menu-close`. The listener closes the mobile menu when the viewport becomes desktop.
ENG-003 §11.1 AC-41 / ENG-005 §4.4: `hero video source swap`. Chooses the light mobile asset below md.

ENG-005 §4.4: `parallax desktop branch` + `parallax mobile branch - ONE PIXEL BELOW lg`. ONE call site declaring TWO width conditions, which is why an entry may claim more than one condition. `reduceMotion` is pinned structurally by the full `args` text but is not a width condition, so it is not a requirement row.

deliberately_not_entries.why: srcset hints consumed by next/image. No branch is taken at runtime; the AST sees a JSX attribute, not a call site. QA-004 §4 confirms the old gate correctly ignored these.

zero-argument factories carry no condition. They are listed in the gate output for transparency so a reader can see they were seen and classified, but an inventory entry for one would be a claim about nothing.
